# edition of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:editionOf`](gmeow-editionOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/editionOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/coreference`](../../slices/coreference.md)

Relates a concrete edition, issue, or manifestation of a creative work to the stable work it editions. Functional per edition, non-merge semantics: editions remain first-class works with their own identifiers, dates, rights, and provenance.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md); functional
